Enjoy outdoor living on the private patio, and take advantage of the detached 2-car garage with ample storage.Situated in the sought-after Rowayton school district, this home combines comfort, style, and location. Don't miss this rare opportunity to live in one of the area's most coveted communities. This home is completely turn-key!
